---
title: "TAOOH — no-treatment sentinel"
subtitle: "Reduced second-order API/data sentinel before primary fits"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This no-treatment sentinel validates the second-order Markov data contract and
the reviewed `markov.misc::blrm_markov()` API before the 50 full models. It is a
reduced model with no treatment term; numeric weekly time infers its starting
profile from week 1, which remains in the sentinel data. Posterior
standardization is not performed in this sentinel.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-validation.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))

runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
cohort_path <- project_path("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
taooh_path <- project_path("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-taooh.parquet")
cohort_schema_path <- project_path("data", "schema", "cohort_follow_up.yml")
taooh_schema_path <- project_path("data", "schema", "taooh.yml")
output_path <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "no-treatment-sentinel.rds")
stage_id <- "primary-taooh-no-treatment-sentinel"
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"), here::here("R", "data-validation.R"),
  here::here("R", "data-helpers.R"), here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"), here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"),
  knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-sentinel
#| include: false
module_branch(
  runtime = runtime,
  stage_id = stage_id,
  input_paths = c(cohort_path, taooh_path, cohort_schema_path, taooh_schema_path),
  output_paths = output_path,
  code_paths = code_paths,
  metadata = list(endpoint = "taooh", sentinel = TRUE, assignment = "none", order = 2L),
  worker = function() {
    cohort <- module_input(cohort_path, cohort_schema_path)
    taooh <- module_input(taooh_path, taooh_schema_path)
    module_require_columns(cohort, c("id", "tx"), "cohort_follow_up")
    module_require_columns(taooh, c("id", "week", "y_taooh"), "taooh")
    if (any(!taooh$y_taooh %in% 1:5)) stop("TAOOH states must be exactly 1 = home, 2 = planned, 3 = ER, 4 = unplanned, 5 = dead.")
    taooh <- taooh[order(taooh$id, taooh$week), , drop = FALSE]
    bad_absorbing <- any(unlist(tapply(taooh$y_taooh, taooh$id, function(value) {
      death <- which(value == 5L)
      length(death) > 0L && any(value[seq.int(death[1L], length(value))] != 5L)
    })))
    if (bad_absorbing) stop("TAOOH death state 5 must be absorbing within every patient.")
    data <- taooh[, c("id", "week", "y_taooh"), drop = FALSE]
    data$y <- factor(data$y_taooh, levels = 1:5, ordered = TRUE)
    data$yprev <- ave(data$y_taooh, data$id, FUN = function(value) c(value[1L], head(value, -1L)))
    data$ypprev <- ave(data$y_taooh, data$id, FUN = function(value) c(value[1L], value[1L], head(value, -2L)))
    data$yprev <- factor(data$yprev, levels = 1:5, ordered = FALSE)
    data$ypprev <- factor(data$ypprev, levels = 1:5, ordered = FALSE)
    if (!any(!is.na(data$y) & !is.na(data$yprev) & !is.na(data$ypprev))) stop("TAOOH sentinel has no usable history.")
    model_formula <- y ~ rms::rcs(week, 3) + yprev + ypprev
    fit_seed <- analysis_seed(config, "taooh")
    fit <- tryCatch(
      markov.misc::blrm_markov(
        formula = model_formula,
        ppo = ~week,
        cppo = function(y) y,
        data = data,
        id_var = "id",
        time_var = "week",
        random_intercept = "id",
        p_var = "yprev",
        p2_var = "ypprev",
        chains = as.integer(config$markov$chains),
        iter = as.integer(config$markov$iterations),
        warmup = as.integer(config$markov$warmup),
        seed = fit_seed,
        refresh = 0L
      ),
      error = identity
    )
    diagnostics <- if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
      fit
    } else {
      tryCatch(markov_diagnostics(fit, config$diagnostics), error = identity)
    }
    retry <- inherits(fit, "error") || inherits(diagnostics, "error") ||
      !isTRUE(diagnostics$passed)
    if (retry) {
      if (!isTRUE(config$diagnostics$retry_on_failure)) {
        stop("TAOOH sentinel fit failed and retries are disabled.")
      }
      fit <- markov.misc::blrm_markov(
        formula = model_formula,
        ppo = ~week,
        cppo = function(y) y,
        data = data,
        id_var = "id",
        time_var = "week",
        random_intercept = "id",
        p_var = "yprev",
        p2_var = "ypprev",
        chains = as.integer(config$markov$chains),
        iter = as.integer(config$markov$retry_iterations),
        warmup = as.integer(config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L),
        seed = as.integer(fit_seed + 500000L),
        refresh = 0L
      )
      diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(fit, config$diagnostics)
    }
    assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)
    module_save_rds(list(model = fit, diagnostics = diagnostics), output_path)
  }
)
```
